name: ask-mod
description: A richer AskUserQuestion: a context strip above the engine's own dialog (how many questions, their header chips, who asked, the paragraph Claude wrote right before asking, and 上次選過 for a question you have answered before) and a compare pane beside or below it that lays every option out as a card with its description and its preview rendered - a diff as a diff, fenced code as code, prose as markdown - so you read all of them at once instead of one focused option at a time. The dialog itself is untouched and keeps the keyboard. Needs function hooks (early access). Zero model tokens.

compare.title: 比較板
compare.description: auto: 這一輪有 preview、不只一題、或至少一半選項帶說明時自動開比較板（原生對話框一次只給你看一塊的情況）；always: 每一輪有選擇題就開；off: 不開、也不註冊 /ask-compare，只留對話框上面的脈絡列。你自己的動作優先：/ask-compare 這個 session 都開，手動關掉就這個 session 都不開。

showLead.title: 顯示上文
showLead.description: 在對話框上方帶一行 Claude 問這題之前最後寫的那段話，提醒你它為什麼問。

showHistory.title: 標記上次選過
showHistory.description: 記住你對每個問題選了什麼（跨 session），下次同一題再出現時在脈絡列寫一行 ↺ 上次選 …，比較板的那張卡也標 ↺ 上次選過。

previewLines.title: 每張卡的 preview 行數上限
previewLines.description: 超過的行數折起來，卡片底部寫還有幾行。diff 不折，折了就畫不出 diff 著色。

cardMinColumns.title: 並排卡片的最小寬度
cardMinColumns.description: 比較板夠寬、每張卡至少能有這麼多格時選項才並排；不夠就改成上下堆疊。
